new_findings.file_line: crates/hsk-studio-press/src/show_text.rs:610-639 (pages() walks only /Root /Pages /Kids), :644-672 (content_role_streams: /Subtype /Form, PatternType 1, own /Resources, Type3 CharProcs only); src/sanitized_save.rs:756-760 (Stray walk only for content_role_streams), :804-812 (unwalked stream: parse_content_ext for raw operands only, no walker), :830-833 (code spellings only for walker.resources_used); V4-06 site sanitized_save.rs:799@1c3fd8c (=:809 at head) verdict 'n/a ... it has no resources'
new_findings.evidence: A page object outside the page tree (a /Names /Templates template page, ISO 32000 12.7.6; or a page reached only through an outline /Dest, /OpenAction or annotation /P) is reachable, so save_full copies it, but it is never walked. Its content stream has no /Subtype and no own /Resources (they live on the page dictionary), so it is neither a page segment nor a content_role_stream. Step 4 only tokenizes it for raw string operands. Consequences: (1) Type0 text without /ToUnicode (or simple-font text with unmappable /Differences names) is never flagged, so opaque_text_streams stays empty and OpaqueText never blocks; (2) Type0 + /ToUnicode (or /Differences) codes spelling the removed string are never read (no mapped text, no code variants because resources_used is empty), so they are not a hit. Example: catalog /Names << /Templates << /Names [(t) 30 0 R] >> >>, 30 = page dict with /Resources << /Font << /F3 23 0 R >> >> /Contents 31 0 R, 31 = 'BT /F3 12 Tf <0101...010C> Tj ET' (font 23 = r7_fonts Identity-H, no ToUnicode). redact_and_save of a region holding (SECRET-ALPHA): is_proven() true. The DESCRIPTOR tounicode claim ('composite-font text without a usable map is listed in opaque_text_streams') and the site-799 verdict premise ('it has no resources') are false for these streams.
new_findings.remediation: Walk every reachable page object (Type /Page or /Template, any dict with /Contents and /Resources or inherited /Resources), not only the /Pages tree, as role Stray (not Kept) with its resources; or treat any content-looking stream the walker did not reach but that is reachable as unreadable (UnreadableContent) when a needle search ran. Add a template-page test (opaque and ToUnicode variants).

new_findings.kind: decoding_disagreement (proof narrower than the crate's own appearance scan and than a viewer)
new_findings.file_line: crates/hsk-studio-press/src/show_text.rs:448-453 (composite: mapped gets ' ' after every string of a TJ), :469-474 (simple: every reading gets ' ' after every string; readings equal to the bytes are dropped), :490 (rec.all joins a TJ's strings); src/sanitized_save.rs:772-789 (proof matches ONLY rec.mapped and skips records whose mapped text is empty), :834-842 (byte scan is contiguous), :843-875 (string operands one at a time); src/text_fields.rs:832 (text-field scan matches shown.all, joined); src/redaction.rs:589-606 (needles are single TJ elements)
new_findings.evidence: Text one TJ draws as one run is never read as one run by the proof. Annotation appearance 'BT /F1 12 Tf [(SECRET-) -15 (ALPHA)] TJ ET' (Helvetica, StandardEncoding): bytes 'SECRET-) -15 (ALPHA' do not match; neither string operand holds the needle; the encoding reading equals the bytes so mapped is empty and the record is skipped (:772). Result: no hit, is_clean true, though a viewer draws and extracts 'SECRET-ALPHA' and the same crate's text-field scan (shown.all) finds it. Same with Type0+ToUnicode or /Differences codes split over TJ elements ([<0101...0107> -15 <0108...010C>] TJ): mapped = 'SECRET- ALPHA ', and the hex code variant is split by '> -15 <'. Kerned TJ is how most producers write text, so the same name kerned differently in an appearance or stray form survives a proven redaction. DESCRIPTOR context_rule claims 'ALL text of annotation /AP appearance streams' is a hit. (Kept page text is unaffected: a collision either way.)
new_findings.remediation: In the walker also emit the per-operator joined reading (all strings of one TJ, every reading, no separator) and match needles against it for Appearance/Stray records (and against the joined byte reading, which rec.all already builds); consider joining consecutive show operators of one BT on the same line. Test: kerned appearance with Standard, ToUnicode and /Differences fonts.

new_findings.kind: proof_gap (R5/R6 family: proven while text was never checked) on the removal side
new_findings.file_line: crates/hsk-studio-press/src/redaction.rs:287-298 (unicode_of -> None for composite text without /ToUnicode and for an opaque simple-font reading), :264 (SimpleEncoding::of_font(..).ok(): an InputLimit silently means 'no encoding', so the reading is lost); src/sanitized_save.rs:285-293 (needle text falls back to the PDFDoc reading of the CODES), :993-1012 (needles/unicode passed through; text-field strings = same fallback), :927-945 (no NotProven reason for a removed string that has no reading)
new_findings.evidence: When the region text is drawn with a font the crate cannot read, removed_unicode is None and the needle is only its glyph codes. The words themselves are never searched, so the same words elsewhere (outline /Title, /Info, annotation /Contents, a readable font on another page) are invisible to the proof and to the text-field pass, and is_proven() reads true as soon as no OTHER opaque text remains in the output. Example: r7_fonts font 23 (Identity-H, no ToUnicode) draws <010101020103010401050106> in the region; outline /Title (SECRET-ALPHA plan); nothing else uses font 23. Needle variants = the 12 code bytes and their hex; no hit; opaque_text_streams empty (the opaque text was removed); is_proven() true; redact_and_save_with(TextFieldPolicy) leaves the title because its strings are the same garbage. This is the fail-open twin of differences_encoded_text_is_found_proven_and_redacted (b), which asserts NOT proven for the readable case.
new_findings.remediation: If any distinctive removed string has no complete reading (composite without usable map, opaque simple-font reading, encoding skipped by budget), withhold is_proven with a typed reason (OpaqueText or a new UnreadableRemovedText); keep region_cleared. Do not map InputLimit to 'no encoding' at redaction.rs:264 (propagate or mark unreadable). Test both font kinds.

new_findings.kind: PLR-039_counterexample (selector miss repeats; backstop never sees unselected text)
new_findings.file_line: crates/hsk-studio-press/src/redaction.rs:308-328 (show: advance = Widths/1000 x Tfs for every simple font incl. Type3, FontMatrix never read; box -0.25..+0.95 Tfs; advance always along x), :252-266 (Type3 not distinguished, exact = known && !composite), :589-597 (TJ kerning); src/sanitized_save.rs:1013-1022 (residual = the same selector); src/lib.rs:78 DESCRIPTOR redaction.geometry 'exact advance with /Widths' and proof.independence 'PLR-039 superseded'
new_findings.evidence: Yes, the Type3 residual makes a REGION redaction miss Type3 text and still report cleared. ISO 32000 9.4.4: w0 is in glyph space; only non-Type3 fonts have glyph space = 1/1000 text space; a Type3 font maps glyph space through /FontMatrix. Type3 font with /FontMatrix [1 0 0 1 0 0] and /Widths [0.6 ...] (pdfTeX PK fonts use non-0.001 matrices): 'BT /T3 10 Tf 100 700 Td (AAAAAAAAAA) Tj (SECRET) Tj ET' draws SECRET at x 160..196. The selector computes advance 0.06 for the first run, places SECRET at 100.06..100.096, so region [150 690 210 715] selects nothing; report complete (text never raises an unsupported class), residual pass repeats the miss (0), no removed string -> needles_searched 0, so region_cleared() and is_proven() are true while SECRET is drawn inside the region. Same class: composite fonts with vertical writing (/Encoding /Identity-V, WMode 1) advance along y but show() advances along x (no WMode/Identity-V handling in redaction.rs), so glyphs below the first are mispositioned. The payload backstop cannot catch any of this: it searches only strings the selector removed.
new_findings.remediation: Lead decision (re-open PLR-039): either make the selector FontMatrix-aware for Type3 (advance = Widths x FontMatrix[0] x Tfs; vertical extent from FontBBox x FontMatrix) and WMode-aware for composite fonts, or fail closed (Type3 or vertical text on a page with a region -> unbounded box or RegionIncomplete). Correct DESCRIPTOR geometry/independence wording (V4-07).

new_findings.file_line: crates/hsk-studio-press/src/sanitized_save.rs:431-451 (shown_needles: the operator's RAW string bytes carrying the needle exempt it), :814-827, :848-856
new_findings.evidence: A kept show operator whose bytes equal the needle but whose font draws other glyphs (/Differences remapping, Symbol, Type3) is still a kept-text collision: e.g. kept 'BT /F9 12 Tf (SECRET-ALPHA) Tj ET' with F9 /Differences [65 /X /X ...] draws 'XXXXXX-XXXXX', yet the needle bytes in that operand are exempt. new_findings.kind: opaque_rule_gap (v4_06_class of this lane: a code read by a rule narrower than what a viewer draws)
new_findings.file_line: crates/hsk-studio-press/src/encoding.rs:336-344 (stem = text before the first '.', empty components dropped, empty text -> Glyph::Blank), :297-301 (Blank -> Slot::NoGlyph), :155-158 (NoGlyph without a /ToUnicode entry is NOT opaque)
new_findings.evidence: Any glyph name whose AGL stem is empty (every name starting with a period such as /.s1 or /.A, and names of underscores only such as /_ or /__) is read as 'draws no text' and never opaque, while /g1 is opaque. A viewer draws such a glyph from the font: a Type3 CharProcs entry /.s1 or a glyph of that name in an embedded font program. Example: diff_ap_doc-style appearance with a Type3 font /Encoding << /Differences [1 /.s1 /.s2 /.s3 /.s4 /.s5 /.s6] >> whose CharProcs draw S E C R E T: read.text empty, opaque false, mapped empty -> no hit, no OpaqueText; the same text in page content is also not opaque. Only /.notdef is defined as no glyph (ISO 32000 9.6.5); everything else with no AGL text is unmappable, which the lane's decision says must be opaque. No test covers it (glyph_names_follow_the_agl_specification accepts '' and '.notdef' as Blank only).
new_findings.remediation: Return Glyph::Blank only for the exact name .notdef (and genuinely empty text from a mapped component); an empty stem from any other name is Glyph::Unknown. Add /.x and /_ cases to unmappable_glyph_names_and_encodingless_fonts_are_opaque.
